violation_type.title: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met (26 TAC §746.1613(a))
violation_type.short_title: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met
violation_type.typical_finding: One classroom had reduced ratios for nap time that included a combination of infants and toddlers with 18 children to one caregiver. They are over ratio with nap time reductions not able to be used for this group.

finding_variants.text: One classroom had reduced ratios for nap time that included a combination of infants and toddlers with 18 children to one caregiver. They are over ratio with nap time reductions not able to be used for this group.
A classroom of napping children was out of ratios due to the presence of a 17 month old child. They had reduce number of caregivers to one, which was not allowed due to the infant being present.
Observed one caregiver supervising 10 children, ages 13 to 18 mos, during naptime.     This was corrected when the second caregiver entered the classroom shortly after CCR.

During the monitoring inspection it was observed that the operation was reducing number of caregivers during naptime for children that were under 18 months old. There was a combined nap room with children ranging from 13 months to 2 years old in a 1 caregiver to 16 children ratio.

A 14 month old infant was mixed with a toddler classroom during nap time. There were a total of 13 children and the specified age group was two. Due to the child being an infant the caregivers ratio could not be reduced  leaving the teacher out of ratio.
There were 4 infants under the age of 17 months that was mixed with children 18 months and older during naptime.
